item.title: Fight Laugh Feast: Prodigal America & All The Years That Came Before [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: Join the CrossPolitic crew as they reminisce about past Fight Laugh Feast Conferences and dive into unforgettable moments that shapedFLF. From epic talks to behind-the-scenes laughs, take a journey with us through all the years that led to this conference. Don’t miss this look back as we gear up for our biggest event yet!

item.title: Navy At War With Conservative Christians? w/ Michael Cassidy & Davis Younts [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: A Marine officer faces court martial for destroying a Satanic display at the Iowa Capitol. But was it vandalism or spiritual warfare? LtCol. Michael Cassidy and Davis Yountz join us to discuss what happens when Christian warriors take the battle against darkness literally. It's time to talk about modern day idol smashing and why some fights are worth the cost.
item.author: Gabe Rench, Chocolate Knox Toby Sumpter
item.itunes:author: Gabe Rench, Chocolate Knox Toby Sumpter

item.title: Drinking Beer, Singing Psalms, And Dangerous Christianity w/ Aaron Snell (Flashback Friday) [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: Join us for Flashback Friday as music director Aaron Snell dives into the heart of Beer and Psalms! From the power of communal singing and Christian camaraderie to the boldness of faith in today's world, Snell unpacks the importance of worship in shaping "dangerous Christianity." Plus, we tackle topics like trust in the FBI and the Mar-a-Lago raid, exploring what it means to live out fearless faith. Grab a drink and sing along—this episode hits all the right notes!
item.author: Gabe Rench, Toby Sumpter, Chocolate Knox
item.itunes:author: Gabe Rench, Toby Sumpter, Chocolate Knox

item.title: Who Really Owns Your Home (Its Not You) [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: Indiana State Rep JD Prescott joins us to expose how government plays god with your property rights. We're diving into his bold plan to abolish property tax - because paying rent to the government on land you 'own' isn't just bad policy, it's idolatry. Time to talk about real property rights and why Caesar needs to back off your front lawn.

item.title: The Day Kamala Replaced Jesus + Beer & Psalms [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: When Kamala took the pulpit at New Birth Church, it wasn't just political theater - it was a symptom of spineless shepherds. Join Knox, Gabe, and Pastor Toby for Beer & Psalms as they dissect what happens when pastors trade their calling for political popularity. Warning: contains traces of righteous indignation.

item.title: Multiculturalism & The Church w/ Stephen Wolfe [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: The multicultural globalists want to blend all cultures into a bland humanism, but the blood-and-soil types end up insisting on superficial divisions. Covenant is the key to an earthy and biblical unity and diversity, or what we might call a Protestant feudalism and Christendom. - Toby Sumpter.
